rank_genes_groups_by_cov: compute differentially expressed genes for each covariate category in a single-cell AnnData object using scanpy
rank_genes_groups: compute differentially expressed genes grouped by covariate combinations and control cells in an AnnData object
evaluate_r2_: evaluate R-squared scores for mean and variance between observed and predicted single-cell expression data per condition
evaluate_mmd: evaluate Maximum Mean Discrepancy between observed and predicted single-cell expression data per condition using a multiscale RBF kernel
evaluate_emd: evaluate Earth Mover's Distance via Wasserstein distance between observed and predicted single-cell expression distributions per condition
